fields.name: Status
fields.description: Brief status: building | ready | stale | failed.

fields.name: InputFingerprint
fields.description: SHA-256 of all inputs (form data hash + sorted extraction content hashes); detects staleness.

fields.name: BriefObjectId
fields.description: Blocks Storage object ID for the full brief JSON when it exceeds the inline limit.

fields.name: BriefJson
fields.description: The unified brief JSON inline (when ≤50KB); empty when stored in Storage.

fields.name: SourceExtractionIds
fields.description: AttachmentExtraction ItemIds used in this brief version.

fields.name: FormDataHash
fields.description: Hash of the form/wizard answers at the time of brief generation.

fields.name: GeneratedAt
fields.description: When this brief version was generated.

fields.name: ConfirmedAt
fields.description: When the user confirmed this brief; null until confirmed.

fields.name: ConfirmedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the person who confirmed.
